title: Pure Invoked
summary: Pure Invoked fusion mastery build, uniting Aleister the Invoker with modern 2026 Divine Spirit support and multi-Attribute Invoked bosses. The deck recycles Invocation and Aleister every turn without hand loss, cheating out Fusion materials from both players' fields and graveyards to field oppressive negates like Invoked Mechaba, Caliga, and Elysium.

summary.title: Starters & The Invocation Loop
points: Magical Meltdown searches Aleister the Invoker upon activation, prevents your Fusion Summon activations from being negated, and makes your summoned Fusion Monsters unanswerable on arrival.
Aleister the Invoker searches Invocation upon Normal Summon, and discards itself from hand during damage calculation to boost a Fusion Monster by 1000 ATK and DEF.

Invocation fuses monsters from your hand for any Fusion, or banishes Aleister from field or GY alongside an opponent's or your GY monster to summon an Invoked, then shuffles itself into the Deck from GY to retrieve a banished Aleister.
Aiwass, Divine Spirit of the Law banishes itself from hand to search an Aleister monster, and returns from the GY to Fusion Summon an Invoked when your Fusion leaves the field.

summary.title: Opening: Magical Meltdown
steps: Activate Magical Meltdown to search Aleister the Invoker from your Deck to your hand.
Normal Summon Aleister the Invoker, activating its effect to search Invocation from your Deck.
Link Summon Aleister the Invoker of Madness using Aleister the Invoker.
Activate Invocation, banishing Aleister the Invoker from your GY and a LIGHT monster from either GY (or hand) to Fusion Summon Invoked Mechaba.
Activate Invocation's effect in the GY: shuffle Invocation into your Deck to add the banished Aleister the Invoker back to your hand.
Hold Aleister in hand as an ATK boost or discard fodder for Mechaba's omni-negate.

summary.title: The 2026 Divine Spirits & Spells
points: Aleister the Reminiscent Special Summons itself next to a Spellcaster or Fusion Monster, banishing an Invoked from the Extra Deck on summon to search Invocation or a Spell mentioning it.
Virakam, the Divine Spirit of Artifice Special Summons itself next to Aleister and Sets an Invocation card from the Deck, banishing itself to negate an opponent's response to your Fusion Summons.
Invocation - "Grail" performs a Fusion Summon using a monster from your Deck or an opponent's monster while an Aleister is on your field, in your GY, or banished.
Invocation - "Sword" is a Quick-Play Fusion that returns banished monsters to the Deck as material and recycles Aleister or Invocation.
Gamma Summon banishes an Aleister or Fusion from your GY to Special Summon any Invoked monster until the End Phase.

summary.title: The Elemental Invoked Pantheon
points: Invoked Mechaba (LIGHT) negates and banishes a monster effect, Spell, or Trap Card by discarding a card of the same type as a Quick Effect.
Invoked Caliga (DARK) restricts each player to activating only 1 monster effect per turn and allows only 1 monster to attack each Battle Phase.
Invoked Raidjin (WIND) flips a face-up monster on the field face-down once per turn on either player's turn as a Quick Effect.
Invoked Augoeides (Fusion + Aleister) destroys an opponent's monster on summon or whenever the opponent Special Summons a monster, and gains ATK by banishing a Fusion from GY.
Invoked Elysium banishes all face-up monsters your opponent controls that share an Attribute with a targeted Invoked monster.
Invoked Purgatrio, Magellanica, Oceanus, Sorath, De Anima, and Magistus Omega provide tailored removal, direct attacks, and graveyard banishing.

main: Aleister the Invoker
Normal Summoned: searches Invocation; the material every Invoked Fusion names.
Aleister the Reminiscent
2026 support. Summons itself next to a Spellcaster or Fusion; summoned, banishes an Invoked from the Extra Deck to search Invocation or a Spell that names it.
Aiwass, Divine Spirit of the Law
2026 support. Banishes itself to search an Aleister; returns from the GY to Fusion Summon an Invoked when your Fusion leaves the field.
Virakam, the Divine Spirit of Artifice
2026 support. Summons itself next to an Aleister and Sets an Invocation card from the Deck; banishes itself to negate a response to your Fusion.
Invocation
Fusion Summons from the hand, banishing field and either GY for Invoked; shuffles back to return a banished Aleister.
Invocation - "Grail"
Newest support. With an Aleister in your field, GY or banishment, Fusion Summons an Invoked using a monster from the Deck or one of the opponent's.
Invocation - "Sword"
2026 support. Quick-Play Fusion from your field, returning banished monsters as Invoked material; recycles Aleister or Invocation.
Magical Meltdown
Field Spell: searches Aleister and makes your Fusion Summons unanswerable.
The Book of the Law
Tributes an Invoked to bring out one of a different Attribute as a Fusion Summon.
Gamma Summon
2026 support. Banishes an Aleister or Fusion from the GY to summon any Invoked until the End Phase; brings back a banished Invoked.
extra: Invoked Mechaba
Aleister + LIGHT: negates and banishes a card or effect by sending the same card type.
Invoked De Anima
Newest support. Aleister + an Extra Deck monster: destroys their Extra Deck monsters or their Spells/Traps.
Invoked Magistus Omega
Aleister + an Extra Deck monster: banishes a monster on the field and one in the GY.
Invoked Magellanica
Aleister + EARTH: a 3000/3300 body the page's lines use.
Invoked Baybarron
2026 support. Aleister + LIGHT or EARTH: searches Virakam or Gamma Summon.
Invoked Oceanus

Invoked Sorath
2026 support. Aleister + FIRE or WIND: revives a Level 6 or lower monster; from the GY, Fusion Summons an Invoked.
Invoked Caliga
Aleister + DARK: stops the player who activates a monster effect from activating more.
Invoked Purgatrio
Aleister + FIRE: attacks every opposing monster with piercing damage.
Invoked Raidjin
Aleister + WIND: flips a monster face-down on either turn.
Invoked Augoeides

Invoked Elysium

Aleister the Invoker of Madness
Link-2 that counts as Aleister and searches Invocation when you Fusion Summon.
